title: tasks/MANIFEST.lock (lock_version 1)
description: Lists every manifest with its SHA-256. The detached minisign signature over the exact bytes of this file lives next to it at tasks/MANIFEST.lock.minisig, so one signature covers the whole task set.

manifests.description: Sorted by path. Every tasks/*.yaml file in the commit must appear exactly once; extra or missing files fail verification.

sha256.description: Lowercase hex SHA-256 of the manifest file's raw bytes.

rotations.description: Key rotation chain, oldest first. Each link is a statement signed by `from` authorising `to`.

signature.description:
Full minisign signature file text (4 lines) made with the `from` key over the UTF-8 bytes of: "agentfund-key-rotation-v1
from: <from>
to: <to>
".
